title: Moo UI Generic Host Conformance Contract
description: Versioned host-neutral conformance contract. Defines the ten semantic categories from the Moo UI Core production-certification design document's Evidence Model (generic host conformance bullet) as mechanically checkable assertion sets. A reference runner implements each named check; other languages may implement the same contract against this schema and the report schema.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version, independent of the @wpmoo/ui package version. Two-part to stay compatible with the certification schemas' conformanceArtifact.contractVersion pattern.

bootstrapRange.description: Bootstrap major range this contract is scoped to.

scopeClass.description: CSS class delimiting the scoped Moo component layer.

themeAttribute.description: Attribute carrying the Bootstrap theme state (light/dark).

cssRecipes.description: The documented Moo UI CSS recipes a conforming host may serve. Asset-order evidence is only recorded when the host serves a recipe as discrete stylesheets.

categories.description: The ten contract categories, in contract order.

path.description: Fixture document path relative to the kit fixtures directory.

cssRecipe.description: Name of the cssRecipes entry this fixture must be served with.

bootstrapJs.description: Whether the fixture requires Bootstrap's JavaScript bundle.

mooEsm.description: Moo ESM modules the fixture initializes explicitly.

stylesheets.description: Stylesheet basenames in required load order. A host serving this recipe as discrete files must load them in this order; concatenated or inlined hosts carry the same cascade outcome without a checkable request order.

mechanism.description: How a runner mechanically checks this category, including the chosen mechanism where alternatives existed.

check.description: Named check implemented by a reference runner. The name is contract surface; runners must implement exactly these names.

fixtures.description: Fixture names this assertion applies to.

description.description: The concrete expected outcome, phrased as a falsifiable statement.

params.description: Check-specific parameters (selectors, property lists, expected values).
